summary: Request metadata parsing, redirect rendering and navigation, and authority derivation were hardened while preserving supported behavior.

findings.root_cause: A whitespace-tolerant delimiter expression can perform excessive work on adversarial values.
findings.security_impact: Disproportionate CPU use while handling a request.
findings.behavior_before_fix: Whitespace-heavy list values can take excessive time to parse.
findings.remediation: Use bounded-cost comma splitting and trim each value.
findings.behavior_after_fix: Long list values are parsed promptly while valid list semantics remain available.
findings.verification: Local build and protected Jest suite passed (364 passed, 4 skipped); final public reproducer passed 20/20 and revised deterministic suite passed 30/30.

findings.trust_boundary: Destination value reflected into an HTML response
findings.root_cause: The body gave every destination a clickable anchor regardless of URL scheme.
findings.security_impact: A user could activate script-capable link content.
findings.behavior_before_fix: An unsafe redirect target appears as a clickable HTML link.
findings.remediation: Only safe web targets receive a clickable link; unsafe or malformed targets remain plain text.
findings.behavior_after_fix: The response does not expose an unsafe clickable target, and supported redirects keep their normal status and destination.
findings.verification: Local build and protected Jest suite passed (364 passed, 4 skipped); final public reproducer passed 20/20 and revised deterministic suite passed 30/30.

findings.trust_boundary: Untrusted navigation history to Location header
findings.root_cause: The history value was accepted without an adequate origin decision, including scheme-relative external destinations.
findings.security_impact: A back action can redirect a user to an external site.
findings.behavior_before_fix: An external history value can control the redirect destination.
findings.remediation: Accept ordinary relative or same-origin history and otherwise use the supplied alternative or root fallback.
findings.behavior_after_fix: External history does not determine Location; supported local history still works.
findings.verification: Local build and protected Jest suite passed (364 passed, 4 skipped); final public reproducer passed 20/20 and revised deterministic suite passed 30/30.

findings.trust_boundary: Client-controlled Host, forwarded host, or HTTP/2 authority to host identity
findings.root_cause: Raw authority parsing could assign a spoofed hostname from malformed userinfo-like input.
findings.security_impact: Origin and other host-based decisions can use an attacker-chosen identity.
findings.behavior_before_fix: Malformed authority may produce the wrong hostname.
findings.remediation: Parse the authority defensively and return no host when it is malformed.
findings.behavior_after_fix: Malformed authority does not spoof the hostname while ordinary host forms remain supported.
findings.verification: Local build and protected Jest suite passed (364 passed, 4 skipped); final public reproducer passed 20/20 and revised deterministic suite passed 30/30.

preserved_legitimate_behaviors: Valid host, port, proxy, and HTTP/2 authority forms
Normal redirect status, destination, and safe response rendering
Same-origin and ordinary relative back navigation with fallback
